messages:
Lara (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — Helios wants to run a 45min hands-on lab at NorthStar on day 2 (booth B12). They'll pair with EdgeMatrix for on-prem hardware demos. Need run-of-show, shipping plan, and swag split.
Cheng (Events): Ok noted. Booth B12 footprint is 10x10, one 6ft table + high-top. AV: single HDMI input + USB-C. Recommend partners bring HDMI + USB-C adapters. I can add A/V contact.
Priya (Solutions): For the lab we'll run a short private deploy walkthrough + live inference on EdgeMatrix. Plan: 10m intro, 25m guided lab (participants follow along), 10m Q&A. Need stable local network (no internet reliance). Can we reserve a small VLAN?
Omar (Field Ops): EdgeMatrix confirmed — two 1U blades, onboard switch. Shipping ETA to venue: 2026-05-10. They'll ship pallet to partner receiving; our field team will rack. Power: 1x 20A per rack. Cooling note: sustained load ~1.2kW. Bringing a spare power strip + HDMI dongles.
Tess (Marketing): Swag plan: we suggested 600 stickers, 200 tees (mixed sizes), 75 quick-start postcards, 30 premium demo cards. Helios can cover 70% of stickers and 50 tees; we cover the rest. Need final counts by 2026-04-20 to meet print.
Lara (Partnerships): Run-of-show draft link: https://drive.redwood.com/helios-edge-lab (please don't share externally yet). Also need speaker list + slide deck by 4/25. Helios will provide 1 speaker (lead eng) + 1 solutions engineer. Redwood speakers: Priya and Lara.
Priya (Solutions): Lab assets I'll prepare: docker image, pre-seeded dataset, and a short notebook. Suggest pin model to a snapshot so outputs are deterministic for attendees. Will upload image to our staging registry and provide on-device tarball as fallback.
Cheng (Events): AV contact is Marco (marco@av-vendor.com). He needs final layout by 5/1. Also confirm we have a mic for Q&A and a laptop HDMI cable. I'll add a small signage request: "Hands-on Lab: Seats 12".
Omar (Field Ops): Logistics checklist I'm tracking: 1) Shipping labels to Helios 2) Rack install window 3) Power run 4) Network patch. I'll post tracking numbers once labels are printed.
Tess (Marketing): Can we do a small co-branded postcard with a link/QR to the marketplace listing? Need compliance check if we use Helios logo. @Lara can you get logo assets + legal okay?
Lara (Partnerships): Will request assets and legal sign-off. Also propose a quick 30min tech rehearsal remote w/ EdgeMatrix + Helios on 5/6 at 10am PT — cover demo flow and fallback. Who can join?
Priya (Solutions): I'll be there. Can we record the rehearsal? Useful for on-site ops.
Omar (Field Ops): I'll join for the first 15m to confirm hardware boot and network.
Cheng (Events): I'll schedule the rehearsal and add Marco (AV) + Helios contacts. events-bot: reminder set -> rehearsal 2026-05-06 10:00 PT.
events-bot: Reminder created for 2026-05-06 10:00 PT: Helios x EdgeMatrix rehearsal (Lara, Priya, Omar, Marco).
Lara (Partnerships): Action items: Priya — lab assets & deck by 4/25; Tess — swag counts by 4/20; Omar — shipping labels + power confirmation by 4/28; Cheng — AV/layout confirmed by 5/1; I'll chase Helios for speaker + logo by 4/22. Ping in thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
